commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+5' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed low towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
90+4' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

90+2' Well-positioned Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Marvin Schwabe reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
90+1' Substitution. Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) in, Yannick Gerhardt out.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Martin Petersen shows a yellow card to Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) for his blatant foul.
88' Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.

88' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Marvin Schwabe is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
86' Here is a change. Ragnar Ache is going off and Lukas Kwasniok gives the last tactical orders to Youssoupha Niang (1. FC Koln).
86' Substitution. Rav van den Berg (1. FC Koln) on for Kristoffer Lund.
85' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
84' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
83' The attendance is 50000.
82' Adam Daghim picks out Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar.
82' A long ball forward to Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
80' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Martin Petersen had an easy-decision to make.
80' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
79' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
78' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
77' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
75' Substitution. Linton Maina makes way for Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln).
75' Substitution. Jakub Kaminski will be replaced by Said El Mala (1. FC Koln).
74' Daniel Bauer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) replacing Patrick Wimmer.
74' Substitution. Kilian Fischer is replaced by Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg).
74' The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.

74' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
72' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Martin Petersen didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Wolfsburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
68' CLOSE! Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
66' It's time for a substitution. Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) comes on in place of Marius Bulter.
66' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) has tested the patience of referee Martin Petersen and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
66' The ball is out of play. FC Koln will have a throw-in.
64' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
63' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Martin Petersen stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
63' 44:56 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
61' Unbelievable miss! Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
58' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
57' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) offside.
56' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from FC Koln.
52' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
51' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
51' A player from FC Koln pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
49' A lofted cross from Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
47' Great teamplay by Wolfsburg as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Daniel Bauer decides to make a substitution. Lovro Majer will be replaced by Kento Shiogai (Wolfsburg).
46' Here comes a substitution. Vini Souza is given a rest as he is replaced by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+1' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) makes a slide tackle, but referee Martin Petersen blows for a foul. FC Koln win a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
43' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
41' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
40' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
39' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
37' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
37' A clever short pass gives Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
35' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Martin Petersen blows his whistle for an infringement.
33' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
33' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
32' Wolfsburg are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.

29' 1 - 0 A wonderful pass found its target. Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) received it well and shot from about 20 metres out. He did really well to send the ball past the goalkeeper and into the bottom right corner.
28' A long pass finds Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.

26' Marius Bulter fires a cross into the middle of the box that Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) gets on the end of, but he fails to properly control the header and it spins narrowly wide of the left post.
25' The FC Koln players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
22' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post.
22' Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from FC Koln comes to nothing.
18' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Kamil Grabara is prepared to thwart his effort.
16' Martin Petersen blows his whistle after Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
15' The ball is behind the sideline. Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) takes a throw-in.
13' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
12' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

10' The game is pretty dull as FC Koln are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Wolfsburg.
7' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
5' The Wolfsburg players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
1' FC Koln seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
